requirements.title: Marshall minor admission
requirements.summary: Admission requires a declared major, completion of 32–48 units and a USC GPA of at least 2.75. Applications are accepted throughout the year.

requirements.title: Courses before admission
requirements.summary: Students may take at most three Marshall courses before minor admission.

requirements.title: Prerequisites and substitutions
requirements.summary: Complete every course prerequisite. Minor requirements follow the USC Catalogue without prerequisite waivers, substitutions or exceptions.

requirements.title: Unique units
requirements.summary: At least 16 unique units must be outside the student’s home academic department. This is a common minor rule, not a verified total for this minor.

requirements.title: Applicable catalog year
requirements.summary: Students enter under the catalog year current at admission, and that year’s requirements appear on their STARS report.

requirements.title: Marshall-major eligibility and overlap
requirements.summary: Business Administration and Accounting majors may apply, subject to exceptions for their specific major, emphasis or joint program. Consult the published eligibility list and an advisor about overlap restrictions.

notes: The advising page links 2026–2027 requirements. A 2026-10-10 retry with the updated default Fetcher honored the full 120-second robots interval but the linked catalog returned HTTP 202. The former local scheduling limit is resolved; no readable catalog content was obtained. The web reader also could not open the same URL. No access restriction was bypassed.

The announcement broadly welcomes students from all majors. The detailed eligibility matrix flags overlap restrictions for many Marshall majors/emphases, and does not list AAIB under the AI for Business major. Eligibility and overlap must therefore be checked against the student’s specific program; no universal eligibility claim is made here.

The three-page eligibility matrix was visually reviewed. Detailed overlap limits are not enumerated in the matrix, and the minor’s course list, total units, prerequisites and completion rules remain unverified.
The 16 unique-unit rule is common to Marshall minors and is not treated as the total units for Applied AI in Business.
